nodes.text: Two suspected cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) were reported in Nagpur. Blood samples from the two patients, children aged seven and 13, have been sent to the virology departments of AIIMS Delhi and AIIMS Pune for testing, according to Collector Vipin Itankar. (PTI inputs)
